A '''video store''' was, presumably, a business that rents [[Holodrama/Legends|holomovies]]. Video stores were common on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where a [[Video Store/Legends|series of billboards]] were put up in order to advertise them.<ref name="DoM" /> One such video store was [[Pawp/Legends|Pawp]], which had its own [[Pawp (advertisement)/Legends|unique billboard advertisement]].<ref name="Sabotage">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref>

One video store was located at the [[Corner of twelfth and G/Legends|corner of twelfth and G]] on [[Level 1312/Legends|Level 1312]], right next to a [[Coruscant Underworld hotel/Legends|hotel building]]. However, the sign, which read "VIDEO STORE" in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], was was upside-down,<ref name="Catch">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref> while another sign was lying dumped on the ground nearby.<ref name="Wrong">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>
